title: config/published-fact-changes.yml
description: The reviewed list of published facts a deploy may change or remove (I-pub, ADR 0011 decision 4). The content tripwire holds any deploy that changes or drops a vote, roll call or outcome already on the live site unless that exact transition is listed here: path, fact_id, change and value_sha256 must all match (ADR 0011 B4 notes, S2; docs/architecture/ipub-tripwire-invariant.md), so an entry is spent once the live site shows the new view. Changed only by a person's reviewed pull request; allow_shrink never counts. An empty list means no published fact may change. Each (path, fact_id) appears at most once, and listed_on must be a real day (collector/reviewed_lists.py applies both).

path.description: The facts file the fact is in, exactly as the tripwire prints it (e.g. data/facts.json, data/localities/cmc-rpc/rpc.json).

fact_id.description: The id of the published roll call (facts roll_calls[].id; its votes and outcome are what may change) or motion, exactly as in the live data.

change.description: changed: its votes, tally or outcome may differ from the live site. removed: it may disappear.

value_sha256.description: The value_sha256 the tripwire prints on this fact's hit line (copy it from there): the sha256 of the fact's view on the live site and in this run together, for both changed and removed (a fact that is gone has the empty view; collector/tripwire.py change_sha256). Only that exact transition passes.

listed_on.description: The day the entry was added (YYYY-MM-DD).

reason.description: Why the published fact may change, in plain words (e.g. the county corrected its minutes, a rollback).

source_url.description: Optional: the https page that shows the corrected fact.
